每一段偉大的文明，都始于第一塊被拾起的石塊。在這片無限的世界里，你的旅程便是文明本身。
Every great civilization begins with the first stone picked up. In this infinite world, your journey is the civilization itself.

主要內容 Key Features

群巒傳說：野望，以群巖傳說為核心基礎，辅以沉浸工程、农夫乐事等模组，着手于手工業、冶金、建筑、農業、烹饪等方方面面，進行了大量兼容調整與魔改。這款整合包致力于打造更加真實的生存模式，將會帶你親歷人類科技的完整進化史。

Terra Firma Far Horizons is a modpack centered around TerraFirmaCraft, heavily integrated and modified with mods like Immersive Engineering and Farmer's Delight. It overhauls handcrafting, metallurgy, construction, agriculture, cooking, and more. This pack is dedicated to creating a more realistic survival experience, guiding you through the complete evolution of human technology.

真實的生存細節 親手打造石器，捏制黏土，過一把原始人的生活！計算合金比例，鍛打金屬工具，成為鐵匠大師！更有洗礦、堆硝等原始科技流程待你體驗。對了，种田記得留意氣候，挖礦時要小心塌方哦！

Realistic Survival Details – Craft stone tools by hand, mold clay vessels, and live the primitive life! Calculate alloy ratios, forge metal tools, and become a master blacksmith! Experience various primitive techniques like ore washing and saltpeter production. Remember to check the climate for farming, and beware of collapsing while mining!

完整的科技樹 從石器時代到電氣時代，從手工作坊到現代工廠，你的文明由你書寫！沉浸工程家族的模組，涵蓋了礦石開采、金屬冶煉、石油化工等方方面面。更多科技等待解鎖！
Complete Tech Tree – From the Stone Age to the Electrical Age, from manual workshops to modern factories, you write your civilization's story! The Immersive Engineering family of mods covers ore mining, metal smelting, petrochemicals, and much more. Unlock even greater technologies!

豐富多樣的美食 “民以食為天。”群巒傳說作為一個生活類模組，肯定是离不开“吃”的話題的。整合包里面包含了农夫乐事家族、Let’s do家族、作物盛景等模組，添加了数百種食物兼容。快去用群巒傳說的食材來做饭吧！

Abundant and Varied Cuisine – "Food is the first necessity of the people." As a life-focused mod, TerraFirmaCraft is inseparable from the topic of "eating". This pack includes the Farmer's Delight family, Let's Do family, Croptopia, and other mods, adding compatibility for hundreds of foods. Go cook using TFC's ingredients!

完善的流程指引 模組自帶的帕秋莉手册和工程師手册已經涵蓋了大部分模組的內容。額外的任務樹包含了群巖傳說、沉浸工程和原油的主線内容，同時還很貼心地給一些複雜機器附上了圖片案例。自定义機器可以使用“思索”功能來查看制作方式與用法。

Comprehensive Progression Guide – The included Patchouli book and Engineer's Manual cover most mod content. An additional quest line encompasses the main progression of TerraFirmaCraft, Immersive Engineering, and oil processing, thoughtfully providing picture examples for complex machines. Use the "Ponder" feature for custom machine recipes and usage.

更多有趣的小内容 原版群巖生存壓力太小？小心月末的狼群襲擊和秋末的黑熊襲擊！找不到石墨和高嶺土，可以用鋁土礦等自制耐火黏土；煉鋼時木炭不夠用，也能用焦煤和石油焦替代；火把燃燒時間很短，那就來試試煤油燈吧……更多小内容等待發掘，改善你的遊戲體驗。

More Interesting Additions – Finding vanilla TFC survival too relaxed? Beware of wolf raids at the month's end and black bear attacks in late autumn! Can't find graphite or kaolin? Make your own fire clay from materials like bauxite. Short on charcoal for steel? Use coke coal or petroleum coke instead. Torches burn out quickly? Try kerosene lamps instead... Many more tweaks await to improve your gameplay experience.

 

目前群巖野望正在积极開發中，计划更新的內容有沉浸科技、石油化工、星系探索等。感興趣的可以關注一波。

Terra Firma Far Horizons is currently in active development. Planned future updates include immersive technology, expanded petrochemicals, galactic exploration, and more. Stay tuned if you're interested.
